name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina, which hosts a resource of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold. The company published a Pre-Feasibility Study showing a US$494M after-tax NPV and 26% IRR, and received the key Environmental Impact Assessment approval from the Salta government in April 2026. AbraSilver also holds a joint venture with Teck Resources at the La Coipita copper-gold-molybdenum project in Argentina.
